sentences.text:
Deepak Shakhwar Dandotiya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
on 5 March, 2026
 Neutral Citation No. 2026:Mphc-Gwl:7815
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Gwalior

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Rajesh Kumar Gupta

On The 5 th Of March, 2026
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 42238 of 2024
 Deepak Shakhwar Dandotiya And Others
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Ravi Dwivedi with Ms. Kirti Dwivedi - Advocate f
 petitioner.
Shri Rajendra Singh Yadav - Dy. A.G. for the State.
None for the respondent No.2, though served.

Order 
The present petition has been preferred by the petitioner/husband under Section 407 of the Cr.P.C.
seeking transfer of criminal case No. 727/2021, pending before JMFC, Ambah, District-Morena,
instituted upon the FIR registered at Crime No.115/2021 at P.S.-Ambah District Morena for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 294, 506 and 34 of the IPC and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act to JMFC, Gwalior.

Brief facts of the case are that the complainant/wife lodged a report against the present petitioner and other co-accused persons stating that her marriage was solemnized with the petitioner on 22.04.2017 as per the Hindu Rituals and the family of the complainant gifted her in-laws as per capacity.

After five to six months of the marriage, the present petitioner along with NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:7815 2 MCRC-42238-2024 other co-accused persons (in-laws)
started subjecting cruelty on her on the pretext of demand of dowry.
It was also alleged by the complaint that the complainant/wife was physically assaulted also.

Upon the aforesaid, the FIR at Crime No.115/2021 was lodged by the complainant under Sections 498A, 323, 294, 506 and 34 of the IPC and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act before P.S.- Ambah District Morena.

Subsequently, respondent/complainant again lodged an FIR against the present petitioner at P.S.-
Thatipur, District-Gwalior which has been registered at Crime No.359/2024 for the offence punishable under Sections 85, 296 and 351(2) of the BNS.
Being aggrieved by the aforesaid, this petition has been filed.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner/husband contended that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in these cases.
He further submitted that just to exert undue pressure, the complainant is lodging FIR after FIR against the present petitioner to disturb his daily life.
Because of registration of the two FIRs at two different districts, for the same set of facts and allegations is causing undue hardship on the petitioner.

If the conduct of the petitioner had been bona fide, then she would not have lodged another FIR against the present petitioner, by way of suppressing the fact that she has already lodged another FIR at different police Station.

Hence, this petition may be allowed and the case instituted at Criminal Case No.727/2021 pending at JMFC, Ambah District-Morena, may be transferred to any competent court at Gwalior as complainant already resided at Gwalior which is evident from the subsequent FIR lodged by her.

Learned counsel for the respondent/State opposed the prayer and NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-GWL:7815 3 MCRC-42238-2024 prayed for its rejection.
None of respondent No.2/complainant, though served.
Heard counsel for the rival parties and perused the entire material available on record with due care.

From perusal of the record, this Court finds that first FIR was lodged by the complainant on 04.02.2021 at P.S. Ambah District Morena for the offence punishable under Sections 498-A, 323,
294, 506, 34 of the IPC and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
The another FIR has been lodged in the year 2024 at P.S.- Thatipur District- Gwalior, at Crime No.359/2024 alleging the same kind of offences punishable under Sections 85, 296 and 351(2) of the BNS.
The address of the complainant mentioned in the FIR is at Thatipur.

Therefore, this Court is of the considered opinion that the case pending at JMFC, Ambah, District- Morena is hereby transferred to JMFC,
District-Gwalior.
Accordingly, this petition stands allowed and disposed of.
Parties are directed to appear before the JMFC, Gwalior for further adjudication of both the FIRs.
simultaneously.

(RAJESH KUMAR GUPTA ) JUDGE (LJ*)
